name: Sigma - Suspicious WMIC Execution (T1047)
description: WMIC vasitesile uzaqdan kod icrasi (RCE) ve ya Shadow Copy silinmesini askar edir. MITRE T1047.

filter_expressions.expression: SELECT * FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCETYPENAME(devicetype) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND eventid IN (4688, 1) AND LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%wmic.exe%' AND (LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%process call create%' OR LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%/node:%' OR LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%shadowcopy delete%' OR LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%computersystem%') AND NOT (LOWER(username) = 'system' OR LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%sccm%')

notes: T1047 | wmic process call create birbase RCE-dir. Shadowcopy delete ransomware gostericisidir.
